spec_match.rationale: Exercises the exact double opt-in from CSS Sizing 4 §5.3/§5.3.1: frame-sizing: content-height on the embedding <iframe> plus <meta name="responsive-embedded-sizing"> in the child's <head>, with all four combinations (both/embedder-only/child-only/origin-mismatch) live, and covers Chromium's additional allowedorigins attribute (CSP frame-ancestors syntax per html_meta_element.cc + ParseAllowedOrigins in http_parsers.cc), which the spec draft does not yet name — stated explicitly on the page rather than glossed.

interactive.rationale: Four live same-origin iframes with per-frame ResizeObserver readouts, a behavioural verdict that distinguishes active/mismatch/contract-violation/unsupported, and re-measure + reload-child controls; the probe is CSS.supports on the exact property and can return false.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises proof that both sides must agree plus an origin-mismatch case with live readouts; the page delivers exactly those four cases.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers embedder-only, child-only, allowedorigins mismatch, the parses-but-does-not-activate mismatch verdict, and the contract-violation verdict if a control frame grows; unsupported browsers get an honest labelled fallback naming the exact flag steps.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5108373464547328, the spec §5.3 anchor, the propdef anchor, and the explainer.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite (9 assertions) mirrors this page's contracts: all five keyword parses, keyword-only grammar negative, computed-value round-trip, requestResize existence and top-level NotAllowedError; verified rendering 1 pass / 8 fail / 0 blocked on Chromium 141 — future surfaces fail honestly and execute cleanly.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI + CDP (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment): desktop 1280 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 screenshots read, autorun judged verdict 'unsupported in this browser' with all four frames at 154px, zero console errors, only the environmental fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet failures (one per document, including child frames). The ACTIVE success path needs a ResponsiveIframes-enabled 153 build and was NOT observed.

telemetry_health.rationale: Emits responsive-iframe-double-opt-in on the supported path (condition includes control frames staying fixed) and responsive-iframe-double-opt-in-unsupported-fallback separately on the fallback branch; the fallback is never reported as the success assert.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system CSS variables; buttons keep the global background/color pair; focus-visible outlines; recipes scroll in their own overflow-x container; no static-card pattern.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with visible focus, iframes carry descriptive title attributes, verdict and per-frame readouts are aria-live polite / role=status, and state changes are textual (not colour-only — colour supplements 'grew/at fixed default' text).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated checks: scrollWidth == innerWidth (0 overflow) at 360×740 DPR3 touch and 1280×800; case cards stack via minmax(280px,1fr) auto-fit; buttons are min-height 44px; mobile and desktop screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Verify the ACTIVE path on a ResponsiveIframes-enabled Chrome 153 build
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 141 in this environment has no ResponsiveIframes flag, so only the honest-unsupported branch was observed. On a 153/Canary build with chrome://flags/#responsive-iframes enabled, confirm: case 1 grows to ≈420px (verdict ACTIVE), cases 2-4 stay at 150px, and specifically whether allowedorigins="'self'" is accepted by Chromium's frame-ancestors-syntax parser for the opt-in child (if not, the page's mismatch verdict will surface it — record the accepted grammar).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel side by side comparison no horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use auto-fit minmax grid tracks with gap, min-inline-size:0 on cards containing long content, and scroll wide content in its own overflow container.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .lab uses repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px,1fr)), .case sets min-inline-size:0, code recipes are overflow-x:auto pre blocks; CDP confirmed zero page-level horizontal overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status updates for measurement readouts
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce dynamic state via polite live regions tied to the activating control; keep state textual, not colour-only; use native controls with visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: verdict and per-frame readouts use aria-live polite/role=status with textual grew/fixed wording; native buttons with :focus-visible outlines.

summary: The core double-opt-in lab is faithful to CSS Sizing 4 §5.3 (embedder frame-sizing + embedded meta), includes the Chromium-specific allowedorigins origin gate as a first-class fourth case, and its verdict logic can distinguish active, unsupported, parses-but-inert, and privacy-contract-violation outcomes. Verified end-to-end only on the honest-unsupported branch (headless Chromium 141: all frames 154px, zero console errors, fonts failure environmental); the enabled-path verification on a 153 build is the one open item.
